description: Election Commission -  Notify the names of the members returned for the Local Authorities Colombo MC & Katthankudy UC
reasoning: This gazette notice announces election results for local authorities, specifically declaring the names of members returned for the Colombo Municipal Council and Kattankudy Urban Council. It falls under the Elections category as it deals with electoral processes, candidate declarations, and results, published by the Elections Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
